results.content: Published to accompany the first comprehensive retrospective of Whitten’s art, this sumptuous catalog presents the full range of his career across painting, sculpture and works on paper, produced in New York and Greece, with texts by leading art historians, artists and conservators. April/Artists’ Books/Art Territory: NA LA ASIA AU/NZ AFR For his first major solo exhibition in China, Peter Fischli (born 1952) creates a spiraling floor pattern made of city photos from an unknown source. March/Art Criticism & Theory Territory: NA LA AFR ME This is the first publication dedicated to the work of writer, critic, curator and translator Henry Martin (1942–2022), mapping his relationships and experiences across continents and with different radical artistic movements, including Fluxus and Arte Povera. June/Curatorial & Museum Studies/Art Criticism & Theory Territory: NA LA ASIA AU/NZ AFR ME Swiss curator Nicolas Trembley (born 1965), head of the Syz Collection in Geneva, proposes a critical analysis of display methods in art history.
